featured_projects.title: MDC AI Chatbot
featured_projects.challenge: Miami Dade College faculty spent hours formatting and populating Canvas syllabi and quizzes, reducing time for actual teaching and student interaction.
featured_projects.solution: Designed a RAG-based AI chatbot that ingests course templates and Canvas APIs, exposes an intuitive editor UI, and automates syllabus and quiz generation with domain-specific prompt templates.
results: Accelerated course prep cycles from days to hours
Improved faculty satisfaction and teaching focus
featured_projects.description: RAG-powered AI assistant for Miami Dade College Canvas LMS integration

featured_projects.title: AI Pricing Agent
featured_projects.challenge: Shipping and logistics company sales team spent over a week generating quotes due to complex pricing rules and high volume, causing delays and lost opportunities.
featured_projects.solution: Built a RAG agent that ingests historic quotes, product/parcel metadata, and carrier rules, with human-in-the-loop verification for the first 1,000 quotes to ensure accuracy.
results: Achieved 95% accuracy vs human quotes in controlled tests
Reduced quote turnaround from 1 week to 5 minutes
featured_projects.description: RAG chatbot for shipping and logistics pricing automation with 95% accuracy

featured_projects.title: Quantum Machine Learning for Cancer Research
featured_projects.challenge: Intel/IBM Quantum Machine Learning competition required building a specialized team capable of data science, machine learning, and medical biotechnology to identify genetic mutations and biomarkers for Inflammatory Breast Cancer (IBC).
featured_projects.solution: Led cross-functional team combining quantum machine learning, data science, and medical expertise to develop QML algorithms for cancer research, presenting findings to Intel and IBM.
results: Built specialized team in less than a week
Successfully presented to Intel and IBM
featured_projects.description: Research-to-MVP collaboration using Quantum ML for cancer biomarker identification

featured_projects.title: Neonatal NICU Dashboard
featured_projects.challenge: Florida hospitals needed a comprehensive dashboard for Neonatal NICU units with integrated medical billing system for streamlined operations.
featured_projects.solution: Designed and developed full dashboard for NICU units with connected back-office medical billing application, ensuring HIPAA compliance and seamless data flow.
results: Streamlined NICU operations across multiple hospitals
featured_projects.description: Full dashboard for Neonatal NICU units with integrated medical billing system
